description: This is a PHP source file defining the AlertsController class for managing alerts within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for retrieving, adding, marking alerts as read, and redirecting based on alert data.

classes.name: AlertsController
classes.description: Controller class for handling alerts-related actions such as viewing, adding, marking as read, and redirecting within the SuiteCRM module.

methods.name: action_get
methods.description: Retrieves a list of unread alerts assigned to the current user and stores them in the view object map.

methods.name: action_add
methods.description: Creates a new alert or potentially matches an existing one based on provided POST data, then outputs a JSON result indicating whether to show a reminder popup.

methods.name: action_markAsRead
methods.description: Marks a specific alert (by record ID) as read and saves it.

methods.name: action_redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the alert’s associated URL and marks the alert as read.
